description: Enumerate URLs under a site or page without fetching each one. Tries sitemap.xml, then RSS/Atom feeds, then falls back to links found in the page itself; the response header reports which source was used (`source:`), the `count:`, and `(truncated)` when more than 200 links were cut. Each link is one line, `- <title> — <url>` (title omitted when unknown). `filter` narrows by substring or `*` glob against URL and link text; an empty result states whether the filter removed everything or the source had no links. Use it to find the right page before `fetch`. It does not return page content and does not follow more than the first 3 child sitemaps.

filter.description: Substring match against URL/link text, or a glob using *

name: links
title: List links from a page (sitemap/RSS-first)
